title: debpalash/OmniVoice-Studio
claim: debpalash/OmniVoice-Studio — Local voice clone, video dubbing, dictation and audiobook maker. The open-source ElevenLabs alternative.
hook: Hand it a 3-second clip and it clones that voice in 646 languages — then dubs a whole video end-to-end, fully on your machine.
why_good: What it does: give it a 3-second clip and it clones that voice zero-shot in 646 languages (ElevenLabs covers 32), or you design a voice from scratch by gender/age/accent/emotion. Its standout is end-to-end local video dubbing — transcribe, translate, re-voice in the cloned voice, re-time, export MP4 — plus an audiobook maker (EPUB/PDF to .m4b, multi-voice cast) and a system-wide dictation hotkey. Under the hood it's a hub over 14 TTS and 11 ASR engines with GPU auto-detect, so you pick the best model per language instead of being locked to one. Why use it: no subscription, no meter, nothing leaves your machine — and it ships an MCP server, so Claude or Cursor can drive it directly.
value: Who'd pay: dubbing shops and creators working in long-tail languages ElevenLabs covers poorly, and studios that can't send client audio to a cloud. The wedge is the 646-language, fully-local dub pipeline — sell a supported team edition and priced engine/model packs; the value is the workflow (batch, project files, invisible watermarking), not any single model.
risk: Who kills it: ElevenLabs or Descript ship a solid offline tier, or one open model gets good enough that the 14-engine hub stops mattering. It's also in active beta — reliability across 14 engines and three OSes is the hard part. Watch whether a real 30-minute video dubs cleanly in one click without hand-fixing timing; if output still needs babysitting, it stays a power-user tool, not a studio default.

zh.claim: debpalash/OmniVoice-Studio —— 本地音色克隆、视频配音、听写与有声书制作,开源版 ElevenLabs 替代品。
zh.hook: 丢给它一段 3 秒音频,它就能用 646 种语言克隆这把嗓子——再把整段视频从头到尾配好音,全程只在你本机跑。
zh.why_good: 它到底能干嘛:给它一段 3 秒音频,就能零样本克隆这把嗓子,支持 646 种语言(ElevenLabs 只有 32);也能按性别/年龄/口音/情绪从零设计一把声音。最强的一手是端到端的本地视频配音——转写、翻译、用克隆音色重配、对齐时间轴、导出 MP4——外加有声书制作(EPUB/PDF→.m4b、多角色)和一个全局听写快捷键。底层是 14 个 TTS + 11 个 ASR 引擎的调度中枢,带 GPU 自动识别,你能按语言挑最合适的模型,而不被单一模型锁死。为什么用它:没订阅、不计量、数据不出本机——而且自带 MCP server,Claude、Cursor 能直接调它。
zh.value: 谁会买单:做 ElevenLabs 覆盖不好的长尾语种的配音作坊和创作者,以及不能把客户音频传云的工作室。切入点是『646 语种 + 全本地配音管线』——卖带支持的团队版和付费引擎/模型包;价值在工作流(批量、项目文件、隐形水印),不在某一个模型。
zh.risk: 谁会杀死它:ElevenLabs 或 Descript 出一个靠谱的离线档,或某个开源模型强到让『14 引擎调度』失去意义。它目前还是活跃 beta——14 引擎、跨三系统的稳定性才是真难点。看指标:一段真实 30 分钟视频能否一键配好、时间轴不用手工返修;若产出还得人盯着,它就停在高玩工具,成不了工作室默认。

pick_reason: Genuinely differentiated local product — 646-language zero-shot cloning and end-to-end offline dubbing over a 14-engine hub, MCP-drivable — not a thin wrapper.
